name: Fast.com
summary: Browser speed test that estimates your download speed in seconds, with optional latency and upload detail.
description: A one-click internet speed test in the browser. The page starts measuring download speed as soon as it loads and shows the result in Mbps; 'Show more info' adds latency (unloaded and loaded), upload speed and client/server details. Settings cover parallel connections, min/max values and test duration. The interface is available in 27 languages.
